sidecar_contract.anchor_bindings: Every original [{anchor_id,scope_occurrence_id}] in original order. Rule/facet membership and exact selected-source or translated full-context characters/literals checked; aliases are compared only between explicit declarations, not inferred from literal text.
sidecar_contract.attachment_bindings: Every original [{attachment_id,scope_path}] in original order; facet, exact affected-rule membership and attached original anchor membership checked. Existing uncertainty/diagnostics retained.
sidecar_contract.binders: Existing scope validator checks explicit binder variable/domain facets, declared scope paths, escaping references and use outside the scope; no term typechecking or legal quantifier inference.
sidecar_contract.binding_id: Nonblank caller identity; unique across sidecars. One sidecar per existing (submission_id, physical_item_id); renamed duplicate replay refused.
sidecar_contract.modality_bindings: Exhaustive ordered [{rule_index,scope_occurrence_id}] joined to each supplied rule modality occurrence and original O/P/F declaration; cue literals are explicit caller anchors, never inferred.
sidecar_contract.qualifier_bindings: Exhaustive ordered [{rule_index,facet,qualifier_index,scope_leaf_path}]. Exact symbol/multiplicity/physical leaf sites retained including repeated literals; local leaf order then inner-to-outer shared attachment traversal is an explicit transport convention, not legal connective equivalence.
sidecar_contract.rule_bindings: Exhaustive ordered [{rule_index,scope_rule_id}], preserving every recorded rule and scope rule list position.
sidecar_contract.scope_declaration: Caller supplies existing canonical-normative-scope-declaration/v1 payload, input pin and body seal, exact occurrence/cue anchors, connective/shared-qualifier graph, binders, coverage and unresolved declarations.
sidecar_contract.scope_request: Exactly selected source plus declared_context containing the full unchanged verified raw-section text, bindings={}, and physical context artifact SHA. No official-HTML profile substitution, context suppression or truncation.
sidecar_contract.trigger_list: Original archival trigger list retained unchanged; trigger-to-rule linkage deliberately unassessed because archival schema supplies no rule association.

status_contract.null_vs_absent: Null sidecar/map fields remain unanswered and unassessed. Explicit empty maps are checked for exhaustive cardinality on a complete sidecar.
status_contract.outer_limits: 8MiB/depth24/1Mnode ordinary score-free JSON for complete inputs/results. Oversized complete results fail closed rather than dropping nested declarations or evidence.
status_contract.profile_limits: 16,384-character selected source/full context limits; 32-rule scope profile; 65,536-byte scope request/declaration and complete bridge view limits; existing scope JSON node/depth guards. No source, rule, occurrence or context truncation.
status_contract.review_status: Original preflight review status and recording dispute preserved independently of scope transport status; a successful join never upgrades partial, inconsistent, unresolved or disputed reviews.
status_contract.statement_scope_extension: Existing statement_scope_v1 family-extension BridgeView, payload exact and CID replay-validated; no flat canonical rewriting or native lowering.
status_contract.unvalidated_limit_sidecars: Caller sidecar header/input/body seals and bounded closed map rows remain checked and full supplied payload retained, but oversized payload graphs are explicitly unvalidated.
